hero.title: Log workouts. Count calories. Coach clients.

audience.title: One app, two ways to train

you.label: For you
you.title: Train with a plan you can see working
points: Follow your own plan or the one your coach assigns
Log sets, reps and rest without leaving the workout
Track meals, macros and water in seconds
Watch strength, weight and body measurements change

coach.label: For coaches
coach.title: Run your clients from your pocket
points: Manage all your clients, including ones who don't use the app
Build programs once and assign them in a tap
See clients' workouts, nutrition and progress photos
Choose exactly what each client shares with you

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

workout.title: A live session that keeps up with you
workout.text: Start a workout and TrainHub handles the rest: timers, previous results and new records as they happen.
points: Rest timer and Live Activity on the Lock Screen
Personal record medals the moment you beat one
Muscle balance and 7-day training volume

programs.title: Plan weeks ahead, not just today
programs.text: Build multi-week programs, save templates and see everything on a calendar that swipes from day to day.
points: Workout and program generators to get started fast
Import a plan from a file or pasted text
Calendar with day, month and list views

nutrition.title: Log a meal by saying what you ate
nutrition.text: Describe a meal with your voice, a photo or a few words, and the nutrition assistant fills in the numbers.
points: Barcode scanner for packaged food
Calories, protein, fat, carbs and water goals
A recommended plan based on your body and goal

progress.title: Proof that it's working
progress.text: Keep body measurements, weight and progress photos side by side, and compare any two dates.
points: Weight and calorie charts over time
Progress photos with before-and-after compare
Exercise history and best results

social.title: Training is easier with friends
social.text: See your friends' workouts in Highlights, react to them, and cheer each other on.
points: Highlights from friends and clients
Emoji reactions on workouts and posts
Record medals on friends' posts

share.title: Post your workout to Instagram in style
share.text: Pick a story template, add your own photo, and send your workout to Instagram as a sticker you can move and resize.
points: Five templates: workout stats, exercise list, a single exercise's sets and a muscle chart
Your photo or a branded background, with light or dark text
Lands in Instagram Stories ready to post

steps.title: Start in three steps
steps.oneText: Free on the App Store and Google Play.
steps.twoText: On your own, as a coach, or both.
steps.threeText: Get a calorie and macro plan, then start your first workout.

items.a: Yes. TrainHub is free to download and use on the App Store and Google Play.

items.q: Which devices does it run on?
items.a: iPhone with iOS 15.6 or later, Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 12.5 or later), and Android phones with Android 7.0 or later.

items.q: Can my clients use it without the app?
items.a: Yes. Coaches can add clients who don't use the app and still plan their workouts and track their progress.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Open Settings in the app and tap Delete Account, or email support@thapp.pro. See the Support page for details.

cta.title: Your next workout starts here
cta.text: Download TrainHub and set up your plan in a couple of minutes.
